title: All-day freshwater and power generation via integrated photothermally enhanced thermoelectrics and evaporative cooling
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,7916-7927
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02663F, Paper
Wenhe Zhang, Chengbing Wang, Lu Wang, Fan Wang, Puxin Tan, Jinchi Ma, Jingjing Jin, Zhongrong Geng, Hongyao Xie, Li-Dong Zhao
This work presents an all-day continuous power-freshwater generator through enhanced solar heating and evaporative cooling. Scalable series units provide independent, zero-carbon resources for off-grid communities.
